records.outcome: Every DTCG token package update runs under the current skill-factory update method.
records.motivation: DTCG token changes need one baseline, validation, evaluation, invocation, and maintenance owner.
records.why_this_path: The skill-factory plan and target gates preserve DTCG token purpose while enforcing the shared package contract.
records.expected_effect: DTCG token updates cannot be accepted through an untracked direct-edit path.
records.proof: DTCG token receipts record factory planning, RED evidence, target validation, eval validation, invocation accounting, and maintenance.
records.falsifier: A DTCG token package change is accepted without a current skill-factory invocation receipt.
records.failure_branch: Block the DTCG token update, restore its baseline if needed, and rerun the factory update path.

records.outcome: Every repeatable DTCG token mechanic runs through one Mise task graph path.
records.motivation: DTCG token authorship needs deterministic state, hashes, checks, and failure exits around visual judgment.
records.why_this_path: The Mise task graph exposes DTCG token operations while keeping private implementation paths out of instructions.
records.expected_effect: DTCG token mechanics are reproducible, cached where safe, and independently inspectable.
records.proof: DTCG token topology, policy, package, and CI tasks exit zero on current bytes.
records.falsifier: A repeatable DTCG token action bypasses Mise or has an alternate dependency path.
records.failure_branch: Block DTCG token acceptance and repair the lowest Mise owner.

records.outcome: DTCG token visual quality is accepted only by the same strong vision-capable executor viewing current pixels.
records.motivation: DTCG token structure, metrics, hashes, or another executor cannot establish visual quality.
records.why_this_path: Direct DTCG token vision preserves human eye, brain, touch, source-specificity, originality, restraint, and canvas judgment.
records.expected_effect: DTCG token proof cannot pass from unviewed output or programmatic proxy.
records.proof: DTCG token evidence contains located current-pixel receipts and the executor's bounded verdict.
records.falsifier: A DTCG token visual claim passes without direct sight of the exact accepted render.
records.failure_branch: Block DTCG token visual acceptance and obtain current direct-vision readback.

records.outcome: DTCG token values and relationships are locked only after material controlled experiments.
records.motivation: DTCG token defaults and tiny tuning can preserve mediocrity while consuming time.
records.why_this_path: Material DTCG token experiments expose different system directions while fixed conditions keep the decision causal.
records.expected_effect: DTCG token decisions preserve creative exploration and commit once one direction earns acceptance.
records.proof: DTCG token experiment evidence records preregistration, candidates, direct vision, decision, and lock.
records.falsifier: A canonical DTCG token appears before its required experiment or after an indistinguishable comparison.
records.failure_branch: Return the DTCG token to experimental state and run a material comparison.

records.outcome: DTCG token purpose changes, destructive evidence deletion, publication, and deployment remain human authorized.
records.motivation: DTCG token package maintenance cannot infer authority for consequential external changes.
records.why_this_path: Human authority protects DTCG token scope, evidence history, and release destinations.
records.expected_effect: DTCG token work proceeds autonomously inside scope and stops at real authority boundaries.
records.proof: DTCG token decision records identify approval or a blocked side effect.
records.falsifier: DTCG token work publishes, deploys, or deletes material evidence without matching authority.
records.failure_branch: Block the DTCG token side effect and request exact human authority.

records.outcome: A DTCG token skill improvement is kept only when one named dimension improves and none regress.
records.motivation: DTCG token speed, correctness, creativity, visual judgment, or simplicity cannot be traded away silently.
records.why_this_path: A frozen DTCG token baseline, evaluator, resource measures, and rollback digest make one-dimension trials falsifiable.
records.expected_effect: The DTCG token package learns without becoming slower, weaker, less creative, or less correct.
records.proof: The DTCG token improvement task records keep, discard, or crash and verifies the accepted digest.
records.falsifier: A slower or less correct DTCG token candidate remains installed.
records.failure_branch: Restore the accepted DTCG token digest and rerun its narrow and integrated proof.

records.outcome: The DTCG token skill executes one ordered path from source authority through experiments, token lock, authorship, proof, and acceptance.
records.motivation: DTCG token rules can be individually correct while implicit order still permits premature locks, skipped vision, or stale dependent proof.
records.why_this_path: The DTCG token body assigns each numbered step to a real Mise task, model-only judgment, or both, then uses bounded Branch, If, For each, Repeat, and Stop controls only where action changes.
records.expected_effect: DTCG token work locks lower owners before dependents and returns failures to the smallest responsible step.
records.proof: DTCG token workflow tests verify consecutive steps, real owners, meaningful controls, and the source-to-proof order in the skill body.
records.falsifier: A DTCG token step lacks a Mise or model owner, a loop has no stop condition, or canonical tokens can precede their experiments.
records.failure_branch: Repair the lowest DTCG token workflow owner, invalidate dependent proof, and rerun the workflow contract plus integrated package checks.

records.outcome: The DTCG token skill rejects malformed or generic policy evidence without depending on an external factory process.
records.motivation: A DTCG token package that passes only under an external target checker cannot function safely on its own.
records.why_this_path: DTCG token policy tasks now validate research provenance and currency, whole-phrase specificity, acyclic single-path Mise structure, typed invocation receipts, and concrete decision evidence locally.
records.expected_effect: Every supported DTCG token invocation fails closed on stale, malformed, circular, generic, or ambiguous deterministic evidence.
records.proof: DTCG token adversarial behavior tests reproduce fourteen former fail-open cases and now reject each one before integrated acceptance.
records.falsifier: A malformed DTCG token policy package or generic receipt exits zero, crashes with a traceback, or requires an external factory checker to fail.
records.failure_branch: Block DTCG token acceptance, repair the local policy owner, rerun the failing attack, and then rerun factory target validation.
